title: Determinants of Unfolding Cooperativity and Binding Are Decoupled in a DNA Binding Domain.
authors: Rajendran, Divya; Goyal, Saloni; Chaurasiya, Dhruv Kumar; Naganathan, Athi N
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文结合实验与模拟研究FruR转录因子DNA结合域中Tyr-Tyr堆积对解折叠协同性与DNA结合亲和力的解耦影响，核心为TF-DNA结合域的结构稳定性与结合机制，但方法以实验为主、模拟为辅，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: The relative magnitudes of noncovalent stabilization energies or the coupling free energies in folded proteins are anisotropically distributed, uniquely influencing folding and functional behaviors. In this regard, the fructose repressor (FruR) DBD belonging to the LacR repressor family harbors a three-residue insertion horizontal line KQY horizontal line between the canonical second and third helices. This sequence insertion promotes a strong Tyr-Tyr stacking interaction that is not observed in related homologues. Combining experiments with simulations, we show that the Tyr-Tyr stacking contributes to a decoupled unfolding due to the localization of a large part of the stabilization energy in this specific structural region. This leads to melting temperatures from different probes spanning nearly 10 K, while concomitantly stabilizing a partially structured intermediate state. Disruption of the aromatic stacking interaction via an alanine mutation promotes a molten-globular state whose native ensemble is replete with non-native interactions while displaying enhanced thermodynamic fluctuations and minimal calorimetric cooperativity. Surprisingly, the molten-globular variant of FruR DBD binds to the operator site on DNA with an affinity similar to that of the wild-type but with altered secondary-structure characteristics in the bound state, underscoring the chaperone-like role of DNA through its large negative electrostatic potential. FruR DBD thus appears to be at the verge of disorder as expected of an entropically destabilizing three-residue insertion but is rescued by the aromatic stacking interaction that distinctly dictates the finer details of stability, cooperativity, and binding.
abstract_zh: 折叠蛋白中非共价稳定化能或耦合自由能的相对大小呈各向异性分布，独特地影响折叠和功能行为。在此背景下，属于LacR阻遏蛋白家族果糖阻遏蛋白（FruR）的DNA结合域（DBD）在经典第二和第三螺旋之间含有一个三残基插入序列——KQY。该序列插入促进了在同源蛋白中未观察到的强Tyr-Tyr堆积相互作用。结合实验与模拟，我们表明Tyr-Tyr堆积通过将大部分稳定化能定位于该特定结构区域，导致解耦的展开过程。这导致不同探针测得的熔解温度跨度接近10 K，同时稳定了一个部分结构化的中间态。通过丙氨酸突变破坏芳香堆积相互作用，促进了熔球态的形成，其天然态集合充满非天然相互作用，同时表现出增强的热力学波动和极小的量热协同性。令人惊讶的是，FruR DBD的熔球变体以与野生型相似的亲和力结合DNA上的操纵子位点，但结合态中二级结构特征发生改变，突显了DNA通过其大负静电势所起的分子伴侣样作用。因此，FruR DBD似乎处于无序的边缘，正如熵不稳定三残基插入所预期的那样，但通过芳香堆积相互作用得以挽救，该相互作用明确决定了稳定性、协同性和结合的精细细节。
